title: Servicing Periods Schedule — Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)
content:
Waiting periods, renewal timing and notice periods for **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** are counted in calendar days. The schedule below gives them for every tier.

| Tier | Excess Flood 250K | Excess Flood 500K | Excess Flood 1M | Excess Flood 2M | Excess Flood 3M | Excess Flood 5M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Waiting period from receipt of the signed application and full payment to the excess coverage attaching, and for mid-term increases (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Waiting period when bound together with a new underlying policy and starting on the underlying effective date (calendar days) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Renewal offer issued before term end (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Renewal payment must be received by term end, no grace period | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Written notice before term end for a Tidemark non-renewal (calendar days) | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Written notice before Tidemark cancels for a dishonored payment or material misrepresentation (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

## Illustration on the calendar (hypothetical dates)

For a hypothetical term ending on 1 October, a 60-day renewal offer falls on 2 August, and a 45-day non-renewal notice must be mailed no later than 17 August. Because no tier allows a grace period, payment received on 2 October does not renew that term.
